description: Empty-state guidance, on top of 010. Eric chose ghost text in the search field over pre-filling the summary card with a default business. The search placeholder now reads 'Choose your business type' instead of the example list. Also fixed a placeholder colour failing WCAG AA at 4.23:1.

approvedBuild.note: Eric approved builds 005 through 011 together on 2026-09-22, in conversation, after having each change described to him. This supersedes 004 as the approved build. Recorded honestly: unlike 004, this approval was NOT preceded by a live review pass in the Site Preview Screen tool, and no browser QA was run on any of 005-011. It is approval of the design and copy decisions, not a statement that the checks below passed.

qa.note: NOT RUN. The 32/32 pass still refers to Build 004 only. Outstanding and unverified across the approved 005-011: mobile stacking 320-1440px and keyboard tab order after the 005 DOM move; the scrollend fallback in a browser without scrollend support, and the reduced-motion path (006); press feedback and the un-stuck hover lift on a real touch device (007); carousel direction across the last-to-first wrap, search dropdown entrance against its own overflow:auto clipping, mobile nav open/close on a real phone, and the call-flow auto-play firing exactly once (008); and wrapping of every heading, button and label at 320/390/1440px now that Schibsted Grotesk sets wider than Inter (010). 38 mechanical detector findings also remain, all needing rendered output to judge.
